name: Quad-Tour durchs Tannheimer Tal
beschreibung:
=== description ===
Explore the **Tannheimer Tal** on a rugged quad bike. This guided tour takes you along alpine meadow paths and forest roads through the breathtaking scenery of the **Vilstal**. Perfect for those who love both the thrill of the machine and the beauty of nature. A valid **Class B driver’s license** is required.
